title: Kibbeh in Yogurt Sauce
description: Kibbeh in yogurt sauce is a comforting & popular Middle Eastern recipe. This is an authentic Lebanese recipe from my mom that's easy to follow

source.rights: Feel Good Foodie. Functional content plus a link, for internal app testing. Not redistributed.

items.raw: 2 tablespoons olive oil (plus more for forming kibbeh)
items.name: olive oil (plus more for forming kibbeh)

items.raw: 48 ounces Stonyfield Whole Milk Plain Yogurt
items.name: Stonyfield Whole Milk Plain Yogurt

items.raw: 1 tablespoon fresh mint (chopped, plus more for serving)
items.name: fresh mint (chopped

steps.text: Heat the olive oil. Add the beef and onions and cook until the beef is browned, about 8-10 minutes. Season with salt, 7 Spice and sumac.

raw.text: Heat the olive oil. Add the beef and onions and cook until the beef is browned, about 8-10 minutes. Season with salt, 7 Spice and sumac.
raw.name: Heat the olive oil. Add the beef and onions and cook until the beef is browned, about 8-10 minutes. Season with salt, 7 Spice and sumac.

steps.text: To prepare the base meat mixture, add the bulgur wheat to a medium bowl along with the water, fluff after 10 minutes to absorb all the water.

raw.text: To prepare the base meat mixture, add the bulgur wheat to a medium bowl along with the water, fluff after 10 minutes to absorb all the water.
raw.name: To prepare the base meat mixture, add the bulgur wheat to a medium bowl along with the water, fluff after 10 minutes to absorb all the water.

steps.text: Transfer soaked bulgur to a food processor along with the onion, mint, kamouneh spice and 1 tablespoon salt. Blend until well combined.

raw.text: Transfer soaked bulgur to a food processor along with the onion, mint, kamouneh spice and 1 tablespoon salt. Blend until well combined.
raw.name: Transfer soaked bulgur to a food processor along with the onion, mint, kamouneh spice and 1 tablespoon salt. Blend until well combined.

steps.text: Add the lean beef to the food processor, along with the remaining salt and 7 Spice. Blend again until a meat paste forms. (can add red pepper for color)

raw.text: Add the lean beef to the food processor, along with the remaining salt and 7 Spice. Blend again until a meat paste forms. (can add red pepper for color)
raw.name: Add the lean beef to the food processor, along with the remaining salt and 7 Spice. Blend again until a meat paste forms. (can add red pepper for color)

steps.text: Add oil to your hands, and scoop about 3 tablespoons of the kibbeh mixture. Use one finger to indent the middle of the scooped mixture and then hollow out the inside using your finger until it looks like a half shell.

raw.text: Add oil to your hands, and scoop about 3 tablespoons of the kibbeh mixture. Use one finger to indent the middle of the scooped mixture and then hollow out the inside using your finger until it looks like a half shell.
raw.name: Add oil to your hands, and scoop about 3 tablespoons of the kibbeh mixture. Use one finger to indent the middle of the scooped mixture and then hollow out the inside using your finger until it looks like a half shell.

steps.text: Add about two tablespoons of the mixture into the shell and then close the shell and shape into a football with your hands. Place the kibbeh ball on a tray and repeat for the remaining mixture and filling. Makes 24 kibbehs.

raw.text: Add about two tablespoons of the mixture into the shell and then close the shell and shape into a football with your hands. Place the kibbeh ball on a tray and repeat for the remaining mixture and filling. Makes 24 kibbehs.
raw.name: Add about two tablespoons of the mixture into the shell and then close the shell and shape into a football with your hands. Place the kibbeh ball on a tray and repeat for the remaining mixture and filling. Makes 24 kibbehs.

steps.text: Freeze half of the kibbeh to make a second batch of this recipe at a later time. Bake the other half in the oven at 400F for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through. Remove and set aside at room temperature.

raw.text: Freeze half of the kibbeh to make a second batch of this recipe at a later time. Bake the other half in the oven at 400F for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through.  Remove and set aside at room temperature.
raw.name: Freeze half of the kibbeh to make a second batch of this recipe at a later time. Bake the other half in the oven at 400F for 8 minutes, flipping halfway through.  Remove and set aside at room temperature.

steps.text: Place the yogurt and salt in a large pot. Add the cornstarch in one of the emptied yogurt containers and dissolve with about 16 ounces of water. Transfer the cornstarch slurry to the pot with the yogurt. Stir without heat until it’s well blended without any clumps.

raw.text: Place the yogurt and salt in a large pot. Add the cornstarch in one of the emptied yogurt containers and dissolve with about 16 ounces of water. Transfer the cornstarch slurry to the pot with the yogurt. Stir without heat until it’s well blended without any clumps.
raw.name: Place the yogurt and salt in a large pot. Add the cornstarch in one of the emptied yogurt containers and dissolve with about 16 ounces of water. Transfer the cornstarch slurry to the pot with the yogurt. Stir without heat until it’s well blended without any clumps.

steps.text: Parboil the rice with the remaining water for 10 minutes until it’s half cooked.

raw.text: Parboil the rice with the remaining water for 10 minutes until it’s half cooked.
raw.name: Parboil the rice with the remaining water for 10 minutes until it’s half cooked.

steps.text: Add the parboiled rice to the pot of yogurt. Turn the heat to medium and stir frequently until the mixture thickens, about 15 minutes.

raw.text: Add the parboiled rice to the pot of yogurt. Turn the heat to medium and stir frequently until the mixture thickens, about 15 minutes.
raw.name: Add the parboiled rice to the pot of yogurt. Turn the heat to medium and stir frequently until the mixture thickens, about 15 minutes.

steps.text: Add the garlic and mint and baked kibbeh balls to the pot of yogurt, and turn the heat to low. Allow the mixture to thicken for about 10 more minutes, stirring carefully occasionally.

raw.text: Add the garlic and mint and baked kibbeh balls to the pot of yogurt, and turn the heat to low. Allow the mixture to thicken for about 10 more minutes, stirring carefully occasionally.
raw.name: Add the garlic and mint and baked kibbeh balls to the pot of yogurt, and turn the heat to low. Allow the mixture to thicken for about 10 more minutes, stirring carefully occasionally.

steps.text: Serve 2 kibbehs with the yogurt sauce in each bowl. You can enjoy warm, at room temperature or cold.

raw.text: Serve 2 kibbehs with the yogurt sauce in each bowl. You can enjoy warm, at room temperature or cold.
raw.name: Serve 2 kibbehs with the yogurt sauce in each bowl. You can enjoy warm, at room temperature or cold.

review.reviewBody: You're so good at what you present....fond memories of my late Mom making all these foods for our family (7 children). I have a question, what do you recommend as appetizers before serving the Labanieh?
Finally made this and just want to say THANK YOU!!!! This is exactly what I remembered eating and it was so delicious.
I'm lebanese and this is The best kibbeh in yogurt sauce recipe that I've tried!! Everyone at dinner asked about the recipe. So simple and not complicated yet so delicious!
